current_authoritative_sources.publisher: Department of Information and Public Relations, Government of Tamil Nadu
current_authoritative_sources.source_role: Official Tamil Nadu evidence for natural biodegradable clay or mud, rejection of PoP/plastic/thermocol/toxic paint, and immersion only at district-notified places. The 2025 site list is expired; only the safety principles are reusable.
Peer-reviewed ethnographic context for Tamil Nadu naming, domestic clay-image practice and the modern environmental reframing. One field site does not establish every Tamil household procedure.
